title: MUTUAL CHOOSING
passages: There was a date-night runway and a matching kit. There was a clearer statement of boundaries: I wanted curiosity, energy, and choosing to be mutual.

I was becoming more willing to say what I wanted without turning it into an argument for why someone should want me. Connection mattered deeply. So did the way it felt to be inside that connection. I wanted to keep enjoying my life while making room for people who wanted to meet me there.

reflections.prompt: What does choosing each other look like in practice?
What does mutual choosing look like to you in everyday actions? Write down one example you want more of.
Choose one small action that respects your time and energy. You can give yourself time before responding.
